  WHY: the "k" or "t" there follows a lowercase letter, so the guard misses it; suggested minimal fix: also allow the match at a lower-to-upper case boundary, for example `(?:(?<![A-Za-z])|(?<=[a-z])(?=[A-Z]))`, applied without `re.I` to that alternative, or test the title a second time after inserting `_` at camelCase boundaries (estimated lines changed: 3-4).
